title: Trump visits National Medal of Honor Museum
shortDescription: President Trump toured the National Medal of Honor Museum, met with recipients and signed a bill to build a D.C. monument.

title: Trump signs bill to build Medal of Honor monument on the National Mall
shortDescription: President Donald Trump signed the bill into law during a visit to the National Medal of Honor Museum in Arlington, Texas.

title: White House removes this game from new arcade after copyright warning
shortDescription: The White House removed this arcade game from its recently launched video game hub after being warned of possible copyright infringement.

title: 'Desperate stunt'? Legal experts react to $5,000 'Trump Dividend' plan

title: Trump says 1 million Americans get $500. Do you qualify?

title: Ken Paxton and James Talarico clash in North Texas as polls show tight U.S. Senate race
shortDescription: With polls showing a tight Texas U.S. Senate race, Ken Paxton addressed the RNC Midterm Convention in Dallas while James Talarico held a food drive counter-event.

title: Supreme Court blocks GOP-preferred congressional map for second time
shortDescription: The Supreme Court blocked a GOP-preferred congressional map in Missouri, preventing the map from being used in the November elections.

title: Republican convention will close with Vance, Trump speeches. Live updates

title: US Sen. Fetterman rejects 'extremes in socialism' in GOP convention video
